---
title: 'Graduate Seminar: Contextualism and Relativism'
author: "Brian Weatherson"
date: "Winter 2027"
format:
  # Typst rather than LaTeX, for one reason: Typst 0.14 emits tagged PDFs by
  # default, and Canvas's accessibility checker objects to the untagged PDFs
  # xelatex produces. Needs Quarto to be bundling Typst 0.14 or later; check
  # with `quarto typst --version`.
  #
  # No sans-serif headings to fix here. That was a KOMA-Script default in the
  # book, where scrbook sets sectioning in sans and \setmainfont only replaces
  # the roman family. Typst uses the body font for headings, so setting
  # mainfont covers everything.
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    papersize: us-letter
    margin:
      x: 1in
      y: 1in
    mainfont: "EB Garamond"
    fontsize: 11pt
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        // A little extra leading; Typst's default is 0.65em.
        #set par(leading: 0.72em)

        // Heading spacing. The three field lines under each date are one
        // paragraph held together by hard line breaks, so the only thing
        // separating a date from its Topic line is the heading's `below`.
        // Level 2 is the Week headings, level 3 the individual class days.
        // Raise `above` to open the gaps between blocks, `below` to unstick a
        // heading from the lines under it.
        #show heading.where(level: 2): set block(above: 2.0em, below: 0.9em)
        #show heading.where(level: 3): set block(above: 1.5em, below: 0.65em)
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    code-tools: false
    axe: true
    toc: true
    shift-heading-level-by: 1
    date-format: "[Winter] YYYY"
  docx: default
---
